criteria.storage: JSON and Markdown files in this repository. No database and no external datastore.
criteria.unit: One public GitHub repository (a skill, a skill pack, or an official skill catalog)

growth.source: Daily counts from GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers/history. If that endpoint is unavailable, use the daily snapshots in data/star-snapshots.json.
growth.window: UTC calendar days ending on the run date, including that date. If GitHub has not posted the current day yet, the counted days are a lower bound.
growth.logic: Below the star bar, qualify on either the 7-day absolute count and share, or the 30-day absolute count and share.
